description: Local capability declarations for the portable Charter Kit workflow. This file is diagnostic metadata only; it never installs or executes a dependency.

capabilities.impact: The shared charter and evidence documents cannot be read reliably.
capabilities.fallback: Read the supplied Markdown manually and record the limitation.

capabilities.impact: The project working set and evidence cannot be persisted.
capabilities.fallback: Ask the user to provide a writable project directory before continuing.

capabilities.impact: The bundled initializer and dependency diagnostics cannot run automatically.
capabilities.fallback: Create the working set manually and record a host-native check.

capabilities.impact: Branch, commit, and post-integration provenance cannot be checked automatically.
capabilities.fallback: Record the host or manual version identifier in the charter.

capabilities.impact: Native planning, TDD, debugging, review, and verification helpers are unavailable.
capabilities.fallback: Use the portable Charter Kit checklists.

capabilities.impact: Native long-task ledger, seam refresh, and resume support are unavailable.
capabilities.fallback: Use .charter/handoff.md and the task ledger sections.

capabilities.impact: Interactive provider-backed questioning is unavailable during intent clarification.
capabilities.fallback: Use the bundled design-interview checklist and record FALLBACK.

capabilities.impact: The from-zero intent interview has no bundled portable implementation.
capabilities.fallback: Ask the same questions manually and record the limitation.

capabilities.impact: A fresh reviewer or independent process cannot be confirmed by a local file probe.
capabilities.fallback: Record BLOCKED_TOOLING or obtain an explicit user waiver.
capabilities.action: remain BLOCKED_TOOLING until a fresh reviewer is available or an explicit user waiver with limitation and expiry is recorded
